pattern.description: Inline prelude that initializes a kernel error-state struct (err_code, lr/pc, flags) in RAM before error handling
pattern.template_c: static inline void ke_error_state_set(uint32_t lr) { /* @0x2007fee0 */ ke_env.err_code = 2; /* @0x2007fef4 */ ke_env.err_flag = 1; /* @0x2007fef8 */ ke_env.err_param = 0; /* @0x2007fefc */ ke_env.err_lra = lr; }
